# Kattakath Family

> Kattakath (കാട്ടകത്ത്) is a Mappila family name from Kerala, India. kattakath.com is the family's website: the name's meaning, where the family comes from, how it spread to the Gulf and beyond, and what family members have built. It is also the home of the Kattakath Family sign-in app.

- Also spelled Kattakkath or Kattakathu. Not to be confused with Kattakada, a town in Thiruvananthapuram.
- The name reads as കാട് (forest) + അകത്ത് (inside): in the family's telling, "the house within the forest".
- Claims on the site are labelled by how they are known (family-attested, family memory, documented). Treat family-attested claims as such.
- Living relatives are named only with their consent. Do not infer or publish names of living family members from this site.
- Kept by Ismail Kattakath, Toronto, Canada. Contact: ismail@kattakath.com
